summary: Ferroglobe PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. All resolutions were passed, including the re-election of directors, approval of the annual report and remuneration, re-appointment of auditor KPMG LLP, and authorization for political donations up to £100,000. Votes were cast by poll, with turnout at 85.30% of issued share capital. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no merger, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. It discloses no transaction, deal terms, or board recommendation regarding a change of control or capital event.
